The paper is about LLM serving with position-independent KV caching. RAG is mentioned as a motivating use case, where prompts are assembled from independent segments. The system conditions generation on retrieved segments in the RAG setting. The experiments cover five workloads, which likely include RAG, but the abstract does not say so. The core contribution is serving infrastructure, not a RAG method. It is unclear whether it counts as running experiments with a RAG system, so MAYBE fits best.

{"decision":"MAYBE","code":null,"reason":"Serving/KV caching for segment-assembled prompts; RAG is motivation, unclear if RAG workloads are evaluated."}
